description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Seeniyar Kunarathnam as a member of the Valikamam East P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It concerns the electoral process, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls directly under Election-related matters.
